decision: VMM mapping feasible in a microtest; larger ubatches fail the current raw-logit gate; no promotion
verified_graph: same instantiated device-to-device read graph replayed after unmap, remap and refill
initial_failure: Scratch writes were not synchronized before unmapping; the process reported CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS. Passing trials synchronize before remapping.

larger_ubatch_screen.model: SC117 Qwen3.8 Flash Next GSQ-RCO abliterated IQ3_S
larger_ubatch_screen.limitations: One model and synthetic prompts only; single diagnostic run per larger ubatch. VMM was not used for inference.

limitations: CUDA microtest uses its own allocations and a separate graph-read sink, not the ggml allocator or a model graph.
Physical pages remain allocated and are explicitly remapped; they are not automatically returned to the CUDA allocator.
Refill timings omit expert-bank metadata, model compute, cache effects, other traffic and post-prefill decode.
No complete inference speedup or general numerical correctness has been established.
